name: Northern Tiwa

ancestors.notes: Descent per Glottolog classification of Taos Northern Tiwa (nort1550).

notes: Skeleton. Kiowa-Tanoan (Tiwa) language of Taos Pueblo, New Mexico, in a practical Roman orthography. Aspirated stops (ph th kh), ejectives written with a following apostrophe, kw=[kʷ] and the affricates ts/ch are mapped. Taos has a rich system of lexical tone and vowel nasalization that this orthography marks incompletely; tone and nasalization are left unencoded, giving a high PER floor. Taos (Northern Tiwa) has three degrees of stress and three tones per Trager (1946); neither is marked in the practical orthography modelled here and both are left unencoded (documented exemption).
